name: Heinrich Schellenberg
original_name: ハインリヒ・シェレンベルク
source:
Club owner and actor. A vampire who arrived in Japan during the Edo period.

He continued to turn people into vampires after his arrival and it's said that all vampires are related to him. He was also the man who turned Genma into a vampire.

His body has incredible healing powers and it continues to heal until the heart is destroyed.

Attribute: Alpha (α)
